response.sql: SELECT e.status, COUNT(*) as attendee_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance a2 JOIN event e2 ON a2.link_to_event = e2.event_id) as share FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.status ORDER BY e.status;
